title: NintenDAW
author: HugoDzz
selftext: Here's my GBA mini DAW built over the weekend with Astra. Only available on GBA heh. The ROM and a quick tutorial are available [here](https://www.spritefusion.com/blog/making-music-on-a-gba).

comments.author: FamiliarSprite
comments.body:
Am I really the first to type it...?

This is fcking awesome brother! Nice job!

replies.author: HugoDzz
replies.body: Let's remake some 2000's hits :D I'm already making a bunch in that tiny DAW.

comments.author: snakesoul
comments.body: wow, did you use some kind of writable cartridge?

replies.author: HugoDzz
replies.body: Yes: a holder cartridge + microSD here.

comments.author: passyourownbutter
comments.body:
Wow that's some inspired work! Awesome. 

So.. can we then emulate it on a GBA emulator and make chiptunes on PC with it? haha

replies.author: HugoDzz
replies.body: Thanks! Yesss totally! I've put the ROM in the web emulator on the blog post link!

comments.author: Nez_Coupe
comments.body: Dude this is cool as shit, damn sir good job. Feeling my age knowing that song immediately too.

comments.author: Californicationing
comments.body: Great to see amazing new things built on old tech, really put a smile on my face, thank you

comments.author: P00BX6
comments.body:
Wow really cool UI. Did Astra do it all itself?

If you don't mind some feedback - I took a look at your site, the content looks good but for long-form content and blog posts the font gets difficult and tiring to read

replies.author: HugoDzz
replies.body:
Yes it did the UI, though it was some back and forth here, far from one-shot it. But steering it to what I wanted worked!

Thanks for the feedback! I’ll test some other fonts
